proof_body:
by
  rintro x y ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩ n
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ m : ℤ, x ^ k + y ^ k = m) ∧ (∃ m : ℤ, x ^ (k + 1) + y ^ (k + 1) = m) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨⟨2, by norm_num⟩, ⟨s, by simpa using hs⟩⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, ⟨s * b - p * a, ?_⟩⟩
      push_cast
      rw [← hs, ← hp, ← ha, ← hb]
      ring
  exact (key n).1
target_source: ∀ x y : ℂ, (∃ s : ℤ, x + y = s) → (∃ p : ℤ, x * y = p) → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℤ, x ^ n + y ^ n = m
